messages:
tal-support: Heads-up — customer reports p99 spikes (~10-20s) and 502s during heavy bursts on Dedicated pool dp-west-3. Occurs during scale-up windows, reproducible. Escalating.
ops-bot: alert: dedicated_pool_high_p99 dp-west-3 p99=16.2s scaleup_delay=12.4s pending_attach=18
maya: on it. any recent config changes for dp-west-3? min_replicas / prewarm toggles?
tal-support: not that I see. customer traffic spike coincided with billing batch at 09:00 UTC. attaching attach-queue tail:
```
[09:01:12] attach_request id=abc123 status=pending
[09:01:15] provisioner: start_alloc node=gpu-a1
[09:01:27] gpu_attach_timeout id=abc123 err=attach_timeout
[09:01:35] attach_retry id=abc123
```
samir: those timeouts + pending_attach=18 screams cold-gpu start + throttled provisioner. dp-west-3 has burst concurrency limits; could be hitting per-zone quota. check provisioner logs for throttles and container image pulls.
lia: quick mitigation: 1) bump min_replicas to 2 for dp-west-3 2) enable prewarm for this customer route 3) temporarily route heavy customers to fallback smaller model (quantized) to reduce cold startup.
maya: i'll scale the pool now and run warmup. running: `redwoodctl pool set dp-west-3 --min-replicas=2` and `redwoodctl warmup start --pool dp-west-3 --image=model-cache-v2` — will monitor p99.
ops-bot: command accepted: pool_update job=jqk-456 status=running
samir: also recommend a short-term rate-limiter for new attaches: `rl attach_rate 30m 10/m` for the busiest customer to avoid thundering herd.
maya: scaled min_replicas -> 2, started warmup; prewarm logs show cache hits increasing.
lia: opened a follow-up ticket to assess kernel image pull time and implement lazy image layering. filing as infra#789.
tal-support: informed customer about mitigations. will confirm after 10–20m. thanks.
ops-bot: alert resolved: p99 reduced to 2.1s (was 16.2s) after scale/warmup
tal-support: customer confirms latency improved to acceptable range. we'll propose config change (min_replicas=2 + prewarm) and monitor for 48h.
maya: follow-ups: add automated prewarm before billing windows, investigate provisioner throttling metric, consider reducing cold-gpu init path. assigning to eng-sre.
samir: noted. will run a stress test to reproduce attach backlog and iterate on backoff jitter.
tal-support: closing loop with customer; will reopen if regression. :thumbsup:
